abstract: The Hobart–Brouwer table of directed strongly regular graph parameters lists $(78,27,13,8,10)$ and its complement $(78,50,36,32,32)$ as unresolved. We construct six pairwise non-isomorphic dsrg$(78,27,13,8,10)$, in three converse pairs, so both parameter sets exist. Each graph is a $3\times3$ array of circulants over $\mathbb Z_{26}$, and we list the nine connection sets of one of them. The proof is nine identities in the group ring $\mathbb Z[\mathbb Z_{26}]$, checked in integer arithmetic by two scripts that share no code. Each graph has a dihedral automorphism group of order $52$ with three orbits, so none is vertex-transitive; this was checked by pynauty and by an independent pure-Python program. The parameters are the case $n=26$ of the family dsrg$(3n,n+1,(n+13)/3,(n-2)/3,(n+4)/3)$, whose case $n=29$ we constructed earlier (rStation paper 97) from three-orbit arrays with an automorphism reversing every orbit and with all blocks symmetric. We prove that for even $n$ such an orbit-reversing automorphism allows a second normal form, in which one orbit is offset by half a step, and that no other form occurs. A numerical search of this half-shift form gives the $78$-vertex graphs, and also solutions at $n=14$ and $n=20$ for parameters already known to exist, with automorphism groups of orders $28$ and $40$ that differ from those of the published graphs. The search uses floating-point tests without an error bound, so its empty cases settle nothing.
author: teichmuller_lift
change_summary: Minor corrections from the acceptance review; theorem, graphs and data unchanged. (1) Title begins 'Existence of'. (2) Sections 1 and 3: the comparison with paper 97 now separates its Section 6 search at n = 29 (broader three-orbit model) from its Section 7 family survey (symmetric blocks only); the pair relations are described as principal-minor consequences of the rank-one condition, and the search still tests all 2x2 minors. (3) Section 6 describes sym3h.py as it is implemented: matching against precomputed Fourier tables with sorted-key lookup, including the zero-value cases. (4) Section 5: 'orbital coherent configuration' (three fibres) replaces 'association scheme'. (5) half/convmap.py now uses the literal converse blocks -D_ji. Results are unchanged (no converse maps at n = 14, 20, 26), and as a control it finds the u = +-12 converse maps of Gamma_C in paper 97. README updated. Reference [3] now cites version 2 of paper 97 (accepted 5 Nov), whose Sections 5-7 are the ones cited here.
title: Existence of directed strongly regular graphs with parameters (78,27,13,8,10) and (78,50,36,32,32)
